messages:
marta: incident-bot triggered: High error rate from Northbridge VPC auth proxy (tenant=nb-prod). 500s for token introspect. Paging primary oncall.
incident-bot: Page sent to @sre-jordan and @eng-anna — severity P1. Auto-create incident channel: #inc-1768378321-northbridge
sre-jordan: I’m on it. seeing spike in TLS handshake errors in proxy logs. pulling logs now.
eng-anna: I can join, looks like customer uses mTLS + OIDC. Northbridge rotated certs yesterday per their ops runbook. Could be cert chain mismatch.
oncall-bot: @sre-jordan acknowledged the page (1m ago)
cust-success-lee: Customer reports that all signing-in users in EU region seeing failures. They've escalated to their security team.
infra-tim: quick check — dedicated pool for nb-prod is healthy per host metrics. errors localized to auth proxy layer.
marta: paste from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z ERROR auth-proxy: tls handshake failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (client=10.23.4.11)
2026-03-15T09:12:05Z WARN introspect: oidc introspect failed status=502 body="invalid_token"
```
eng-anna: that x509 error usually means client cert presented by Northbridge not trusted by our CA bundle.
sre-jordan: asking ops for exact cert chain they deployed.
cust-success-lee: Northbridge confirms they rotated leaf cert and pushed a new CA bundle to their side. They claim they also uploaded new intermediate to our tenant profile yesterday.
marta: checked our tenant metadata -> recent changes show a config update 2026-03-14 22:05 from user: nb-admin: uploaded jwks only. No CA/intermediate update recorded.
eng-anna: hmm. their client cert chain probably uses an intermediate we don't have. OIDC introspect failing might be downstream effect if mutual TLS session fails before token exchange.
infra-tim: can we fallback to outbound auth to our central OIDC router that doesn't require mTLS? Risk: increased blast radius, but might restore user login quickly.
sre-jordan: propose temporary bypass for Northbridge: allow their tenant to use bearer token path while we fix mTLS. Needs explicit waiver and off-hours window.
cust-success-lee: Northbridge legal already on call, they approved emergency bypass for 2 hours.
eng-anna: ok steps:
1) validate cert chain: get client cert from the failed handshake record
2) if intermediate missing, upload intermediate to tenant CA bundle
3) restart auth-proxy worker gracefully to pick up bundle
4) if step 2 fails, enable fallback route for tenant

sre-jordan: retrieving client cert from packet capture.
```
$ sudo tcpdump -w /tmp/nb_tls.pcap host 10.23.4.11 and port 443
# exported cert:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIF...AB
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
```
eng-anna: I inspected cert; issuer CN shows "Acme Intermediate CA v2". Not present in our tenant CA list.
infra-tim: uploading intermediate to tenant profile now via admin CLI.
```
$ rwctl tenant update-ca --tenant nb-prod --ca-file acme-intermediate.pem
SUCCESS: updated ca bundle for nb-prod (ver=3)
```
sre-jordan: will tail proxy logs and trigger rolling restart of proxy workers for nb-prod.
```
$ kubectl -n nb-prod rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy --timeout=5m
```
oncall-bot: scheduled restart of auth-proxy deployment (nb-prod). ETA 2m.
eng-anna: monitor SLOs and user reports. cust-success-lee pls confirm when customers see improvement.
marta: post-restart logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:21:10Z INFO auth-proxy: loaded tenant CA bundle ver=3 for tenant=nb-prod
2026-03-15T09:21:11Z INFO tls: handshake completed client=10.23.4.11 subject="CN=nb-client" issuer="Acme Intermediate CA v2"
2026-03-15T09:21:12Z INFO oidc: introspect success token_id=xxxx user=alice@northbridge.com
```
cust-success-lee: Northbridge: login rate back to normal, thanks. Some users reported a single sign-on hiccup but cleared. Legal confirms rollback not needed.
eng-anna: root cause: customer rotated client cert but intermediate CA was not present in our tenant CA bundle; upload failed earlier due to a UI validation bug that rejected PEM with CRLF line endings. We'll file a follow-up.
sre-jordan: incident -> mitigated. still running monitoring for 30m.
infra-tim: creating postmortem ticket and tracking action items.

marta: action items list (short):
- [ ] fix UI PEM validation to accept CRLF (eng-frontend)
- [ ] add CA bundle upload validation in admin CLI (eng-platform)
- [ ] add automated certificate chain check on tenant CA upload (eng-ml/infra)
- [ ] add runbook step to verify intermediate presence after customer rotation (sre)
- [ ] outreach to Northbridge with timeline and RCA (cust-success)

eng-anna: I'm assigning myself to the UI fix. Will PR today.
sre-jordan: closing on-call handoff in 45m unless regressions.
oncall-bot: incident severity -> mitigated. channel archived in 2h unless reopened.
